_README: Copy this to vendor_prices.json and fill in YOUR rates, then restart.
It ships with every rate null on purpose. This app cannot know what OpenAI
and Mistral charge your account: list prices change, and a volume tier or a
negotiated rate makes them wrong in a way nobody would notice. A price this
app invented would look exactly as authoritative as one you verified against
Until a model has rates here, its usage is still recorded in full (tokens and
pages come from the vendor's own response and are facts) and its cost is
reported as UNKNOWN rather than zero. /api/usage counts those rows in
`unpriced_events`, so a cost total that is only a floor says so.
Take the numbers from your invoice, not from a pricing page. Bump `version`
whenever you change them: every usage row records the version that priced it,
so a later change cannot rewrite what last month appeared to cost.
Model keys are matched case-insensitively against the model actually called,
so they must match EASYCUSTOMS_LLM_MODEL / _MISTRAL_OCR_MODEL / the reasoning
and fallback models if you set those.
